description: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) at 10 for different configurations of a dense retrieval system as the number of queries used during inference increases. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" and is linear, ranging from 0 to 10, with tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and ranges from 33.0 to 36.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different configuration: "DRP w/o query" (black line with square markers), "DRP w/ gold" (green line with circle markers), "DRP w/ top-1" (blue line with triangle markers), "DRP w/ bottom-1" (purple line with diamond markers), "DRP w/ random" (yellow line with cross markers), and "DRP w/ curriculum" (red line with star markers). The "DRP w/ gold" line shows a steady increase in MRR as the number of queries increases, starting at approximately 35.5 and ending at around 36.5. The "DRP w/ top-1" line also shows an increase, starting at about 34.5 and ending near 35.5. The "DRP w/ bottom-1" line remains relatively flat, starting and ending at around 34.5. The "DRP w/ random" line shows a slight increase, starting at approximately 34.0 and ending just above 34.5. The "DRP w/ curriculum" line shows a more pronounced increase, starting at around 33.5 and ending at about 35.5. The "DRP w/o query" line remains constant throughout, starting and ending at 34.0.
